ela: Quick sync  Need final decisions on reserved-pool spill semantics and autoscale damping for Q3 pilot.

sam: Must-have for pilot: deterministic spill order + envelope visibility + billing event stubs.

rae: Ops: set autoscale hysteresis 6m and min_scale_interval 12m to avoid thrash. Shared_pool_spill_rate alert at 0.5%.

ela: Carryover default = off, opt-in paid addon. Show rollover toggle in Console mock.

sam: For enterprise, allow spill_to_shared=false behind contract; require isolation runbook.

ops-bot: feature-flag reserve.pilot_q3 created for internal canary.

ela: Owners: sam (policy + billing), rae (infra + runbook), ela (product + doc). Timeline: 4w to feature-flagged pilot. Sync Friday to confirm pilot customer list. :thumbsup:
